contract.task_clause:
There are five stages of mitosis that must be carried out correctly for a cell to properly divide. Match the stage of mitosis with its proper component:
Prophase — Dissolution of nucleoli
Option A: Metaphase — Formation of two distinct nuclear membranes
Option B: Cytokinesis — Separation of sister chromatids to their respective poles
Option C: Telophase — Formation of the equatorial plate
Option D: Anaphase — Separation of the cytoplasm and organelles
